requirements.summary: The unhit line, branch and FSM points of the base test are measured with Verilator and each one is tied to exactly one item.
Every item gets its class from a cover trace or an induction proof, as pinned in the item table.
The inputs of every cover trace of the measured unit hit the same point in simulation, and what stays unhit is exactly what the ledger excludes.
A miss within a bound, a bounded proof and an unfinished induction leave an item unclassified.
An assumption that blocks required behaviour invalidates the proofs that use it; a contract assumption keeps all required behaviour reachable.

The exclusion ledger agrees with the proofs of this run; entries without proof, with stale hashes, without their assumptions, for reachable items, with bounded evidence or with invalid assumptions are rejected.
Tool versions are recorded and the sources did not change during the run.
Nightly: the opposite task of every reachable item gives a counterexample.
